task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into OrientDB Studio at localhost:2480 using provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the OrientDB Studio dashboard or the 'demodb' database selected after entering credentials.

task_completion.description: Agent queries the Hotels table and identifies records where latitude and longitude are swapped.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL editor showing a SELECT query on the Hotels class and a result grid displaying coordinate values.

task_completion.description: Agent executes UPDATE commands to swap the latitude and longitude values back to their correct positions for the affected hotels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL editor showing UPDATE statements (e.g., UPDATE Hotels SET latitude = ..., longitude = ...) and a 'success' message or updated record count.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the 'GeoFixAudit' class in the database schema to store audit records.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Schema tab showing 'GeoFixAudit' in the list of classes or a 'CREATE CLASS GeoFixAudit' command execution.

task_completion.description: Agent inserts records into GeoFixAudit containing the before and after states of the corrected coordinates.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL editor showing INSERT INTO GeoFixAudit or a BROWSE view of the GeoFixAudit table showing rows with 'before' and 'after' coordinate data.

integrity.description: The agent must use the OrientDB Studio web interface, not the terminal/console.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar should show localhost:2480/studio and interactions should occur within the web UI elements.

integrity.description: The agent should query the database to find the records rather than just typing the final coordinates from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing initial SELECT queries to inspect the data before running UPDATE commands.

integrity.description: The agent must manually type or construct the SQL queries in the Studio Query tab.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the query editor being populated and executed within the OrientDB Studio interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The corrected coordinates for the three flagship hotels should be: 1. The Plaza Hotel: Latitude 40.7647, Longitude -73.9746. 2. Park Hyatt Tokyo: Latitude 35.68568, Longitude 139.690994. 3. Four Seasons Sydney: Latitude -33.86168, Longitude 151.20766. The agent must swap the values found in the database and ensure a new class 'GeoFixAudit' exists with records documenting these specific changes.
